newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen stable, near-term seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen stable, near-term seen mixed.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices were steady late Tuesday with most traders mixed over near term market direction.
They said paper swaps quotes were higher than physical cargoes indications which mean that premiums of physical barrels are at discounts. This mirrored the abundant supplies, traders said.
Fuel oil prices averaged at a miniuum of 40 cents per tonne premium to Singapore spot quotes, traders said.
November fuel oil swaps were quoted at $118.50/$119.50 per tonne, unchanged from Monday.
Physical 180-cst cargoes for loading in early November were quoted at $117/$119 per tonne.

Traders said news of India cancelling its fuel oil import tender for November 16-20 delivery and the resumption of full capacity of 230,000 barrels per day at Singapore's Esso refinery since October 23, might drag prices lower.
